baseline: pnl_net_open (honest grade, 18:00-open fill, own-pair resolution, base costs); sensitivity pnl_net_open_hicost

random_filter_null.eligible: graded nights of the population with a Detector B value; unstratified (primary) and kind-stratified

detector_columns.pB_dir: 17:xx ET: pB_high_above_cal on up-day nights (MR SHORT / CONT LONG), pB_low_below_cal on down-day nights (MR LONG / CONT SHORT) = P(Asia breaks the RTH-direction level)
detector_columns.pA_adv_k: close of bar k: pA_high_k for a SHORT, pA_low_k for a LONG = P(the trade's adverse Asia extreme is already in); D3 reads k=1 (20:00 ET print) and k=2 (21:00 ET print)
detector_columns.pA_ovn_adv_k7: close of bar k=7 (02:00 ET print): p_ovn_high_done / p_ovn_low_done at k=7 from oos_intrasession (not in the trades table); D4
detector_columns.pA_ovn_adv_k3: the trades table's last value (22:00 print), used stale at the 02:00 decision in D4_k3
detector_columns.pA_ovn_fav_k7: the favourable overnight extreme flag (D4 placebo)

conventions.k: positional Asia bar index (0 = first bar, normally 18:00); 'close of bar k' = the (k+19):00 ET print on a normal night
conventions.adverse extreme: Asia HIGH for a SHORT, Asia LOW for a LONG (fade: the RTH-direction extreme the stop sits beyond; continuation: the opposite one)
conventions.verdict: computed on the A nights of the touched kind (A-either for the grade-changing D2 variants); MR / CONT / graded verdicts alongside
conventions.all_night_effect: rule on A nights only, spread over every OOS night of the window (ungraded = 0)
conventions.nights without detector values: left unchanged by every detector rule (holiday eves, feed-gap nights, splices); listed per symbol
conventions.D3 comparability: every D3 variant, including the price-only comparator, fires only on nights with a k=1 and k=2 detector value

D1.rule: Detector B veto at 17:xx: MEAN REVERSION -> NO EDGE if pB_dir >= 0.70 (BREAK); CONTINUATION -> NO EDGE if pB_dir <= 0.10 (HOLD)

D1_MR.rule: the MEAN REVERSION half of D1 alone (BREAK veto)

D1_CONT.rule: the CONTINUATION half of D1 alone (HOLD veto)

D1_placebo.rule: D1 read on the OTHER side's level (pB_other): MR veto if pB_other >= 0.70, CONT veto if pB_other <= 0.10 (named placebo)

D2_demote.rule: (exploratory) D1 as a demotion: A -> B when the veto condition holds (A series identical to D1; the B series gains the nights)

D2_switch.rule: (exploratory) D1 as a SWITCH: a fade with pB_dir >= 0.70 takes the night's max-EV guard-passing CONTINUATION candidate (re-graded by the engine's thresholds); no such candidate -> NO EDGE; the CONT HOLD veto as in D1

D2_switch_keep.rule: (exploratory) the switch where a guard-passing continuation exists, otherwise the fade is KEPT (no veto); CONT half as D1

D3.rule: Detector A checkpoint at the closes of bars k=1 and k=2: exit at the close if adverse and P(adverse extreme in) <= 0.50; hold if >= 0.90
D3.parameters: 0.90 hold at k=1,2 (the validated 'extreme already in' threshold, pre-registered); 0.50 exit = the tester's choice, not in LAB_DESIGN section 8 or the task text (exploratory parameter, no grid run)
D3.decision_time: close of bar k=1 (20:00 ET print) and k=2 (21:00 ET print)

D3_price.rule: comparator (a): price-only checkpoint, exit at the k=1 / k=2 close if adverse by > 0.25 x stop_dist, no detector
D3_price.decision_time: close of bar k=1 and k=2

D3_placebo.rule: comparator (b): D3 with the (k1, k2) adverse probabilities shuffled across nights (default_rng(0))
D3_placebo.decision_time: close of bar k=1 and k=2

D3_hold.rule: (exploratory) the price-only checkpoint (a) overridden by a hold when P(adverse extreme in) >= 0.90
D3_hold.decision_time: close of bar k=1 and k=2

D3_k1.rule: (exploratory) D3 at the k=1 close only
D3_k1.decision_time: close of bar k=1 (20:00 ET print)

D3_k2.rule: (exploratory) D3 at the k=2 close only
D3_k2.decision_time: close of bar k=2 (21:00 ET print)

D4.rule: overnight hold: a trade still open at the 02:00 print (close of bar k=7) is held into Europe (levels active, else the Europe close) only when P(overnight adverse extreme already in) at k=7 >= 0.90; else flat at 02:59
D4.decision_time: close of bar k=7 (02:00 ET print); k=7 value joined from oos_intrasession

D4_k3.rule: D4 reading the last value the trades table carries (k=3, the 22:00 print) at the 02:00 decision: the bridge's stated limitation
D4_k3.decision_time: close of bar k=7 using the k=3 value

D4_placebo.rule: D4 read on the OTHER (favourable) overnight extreme flag >= 0.90 at k=7 (placebo by analogy with D1's; not named by LAB_DESIGN)

D4_uncond.rule: reference: every position still open at the 02:00 print is held into Europe (the forensics negative result)

D5.rule: (exploratory) tight-stop fade with pB_dir in [0.30, 0.70] -> the same night's WIDE candidate with the same target (re-walked)

D5_rev.rule: (exploratory) wide-stop fade with pB_dir < 0.30 -> the same night's TIGHT candidate with the same target (re-walked)

partly_pre_registered.D3: 0.90 hold pre-registered (detector validation); 0.50 exit threshold chosen by the tester, not pre-registered

effect_statistics.effect: paired per-night mean of (hypothesis - baseline) over the fixed population (vetoed nights booked 0): the group's headline
effect_statistics.effect_A_avg_composition: difference of Grade-A averages (hypothesis A nights vs baseline A nights), the statistic the geometry and vetoes groups call 'effect on A avg'; added so that cross-group tables use one statistic
